profile.headline: Senior Staff Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Staff Engineer at Federato. I build the platform layer under an AI-driven insurance underwriting product — ~17 federated services across TypeScript, Python, and Rust.

Most of my work is the unglamorous kind that makes a platform trustworthy: a Postgres → Debezium → Kafka → OpenSearch pipeline that gives field-level audit history and actor attribution on every policy change; a Git-backed configuration system so customer config is reviewed and promoted like code, written by Forward Deploy Engineering; query rewrites that turned 8.7-second dashboard loads into sub-second ones, custom monitoring to ensure customer config doesn't violate desired query planning metrics, etc. I also own our release-patch process and the CI gates that protect it to reliably release code across 17 miroservices to 85+ single tenant environments

Before Federato: 8+ years of product engineering in React, React Native, Node, including leading distributed teams.
Colgate University '17 · floresfxf@gmail.com

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Owned and developed the entire frontend client layer for Duro's revamped PLM system, utilizing react-query, vite and ant.d design language to create a seamless system for design to export design tokens for frontend ingestion
- Led the rewrite of Duro's v1 PLM platform into v2, the product behind Altium's acquisition of the company
- Created comprehensive versioning, history, revision scheme, CPN scheme, and attribute systems to track components throughout product lifecycles
- Developed a flexible category and attribute system with dynamic unit conversion, allowing users to input values in any unit while storing standardized measurements on the backend and displaying data according to user preferences
- Designed and implemented event-driven architecture using NATS.js within NestJS framework, creating a scalable microservice ecosystem
- Architected and implemented organization and library-level RBAC system with improved developer experience using NestJS decorators
- Collaborated directly with CEO and Head of Engineering on strategic technical initiatives, including individually building Duro's MCP server to integrate into clients LLM workflows, iterating on ECO UX workflows, and ensuring Duro's AI integrations remained on the edge
- Interfaced directly with clients to gather requirements and deliver solutions for manufacturing and parts management workflows

positions.title: Lead Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected + developed offline first mobile apps from 0 to 1 using React Native, Amplify, Expo, Nodejs, GraphQL, Mongodb, SQS, Lamdas, and SST for field workers with little to zero cell coverage
- Configured custom CICD pipeline to configure OTA updates to all mobile applications using Expo Updates and Github Actions
- Overhauled dispatching software to pair with the driver mobile app using React js, Nextjs, React Query and Nodejs

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Decomposed entire monolith API to a service and domain driven design, using severless technology including Cognito, Appsync, Nodejs, Lambda, CloudFormation, and Amplify
- Refactored and reintegrated onboarding data ingestion pipeline to ingest hundreds of thousands of data points in ~10 minutes, an improvement of over 100x, utilizing Apache Spark instead of Flink to capitalize on batch processing
- Maintained and built upon multiple legacy React Native, React, Vue, and Nodejs applications, including bug fixes, new features, releases, and package updates to stay up to date with Play/App store requirements, including target API version and Apple privacy/permission updates, and customer requests

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: - Designed custom pipeline to autonomously parse customers prior year tax return PDFs and pull relevant values to complete a companies tax returns using different AI technology such as tensor flow, google vision, and AWS Textract

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
- Manage Programmatic advertising and internal advertising dashboards using OpenX, Prebid.js, Venatus, and many other tools to make our main product monetizable from our extremely high page views
- Lead User team to launch new user facing products, in turn onboarding multiple new partners and doubling Stanza's revenue within 2 quarters, using Reactjs, Mongodb, EBS, and NGINX
- Transition database from MongoDB to Neo4j while integrating a custom, databased agnostic ORM to ease transition for all engineers
- Architected multiple microservices in Elastic Bean Stalk to replace a monolith EC2 instance to maximize uptime and reduce costs
- Revamped Stanza's release process, CI/CD, stand-ups, sprint planning, and sprint cycles to further adhere to agile development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: - Design and launched multiple user facing products and dashboards using nodejs, python specifically for scrapers, react, as well as maintaining Angular apps, to withstand an average of 30 million daily clicks while iterating through UI/UX designs to maximize user engagement with the assistance of analytics tools such as Full Story and Mixpanel

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Created custom integration for client utilizing an embedded bash script with iframes to inject and launch product with ads in exchange for API use, saving Stanza $50k/month
- Work diligently with product and business development to complete engineering SLA's with publishers and other teams to ensure retention is kept at an all time high with our customers, including but not limited to, configuring and launching scraper built with python, selenium, and mongodb

positions.title: Software Engineering Instructor
positions.description:
- Instructed cohorts of 100+ students through multiple lesson plans to teach full stack / web development fundamentals 
- Designed multiple lesson plans, lectures, and exercises for students to attend/complete the course curriculum

positions.title: Co Founder/President
positions.description:
- Capitalized on need for convenient, inexpensive option for phone repairs within the Colgate community by creating an extremely profitable business model
- Managed business construction and maintenance including financial analysis, contractual agreements, web development, legal compliance, and project management

positions.title: Information Security Internship
positions.description:
- Worked alongside experienced team of security and compliance analyst's to prevent and implement solutions to mitigate merging cyber security threats against the sensitive medical information stored on Baycare's servers
- Performed routine vulnerability assessments and penetration tests while remain within the limitations of HIPAA
- Utilized tools such as Nessus, nmap, Symantec Endpoint Protection, and Wireshark

organizations.description: Prepare detailed financial spreadsheets for the allocations on costs for concerts and large scale events to bring to the Colgate campus to be presented to the BAC(Budget Allocation Committee) for approval.

organizations.name: Theta Chi Fraternity
organizations.description:
Worked with the administration and other organizations to organize, prepare, manage, and execute events for the Theta Chi Fraternity.
Represented an entire fraternity of men on campus and off campus. Served as a leader for the Theta Chi Iota Chapter at Colgate University
